content.name: p
children: Memberships declare which roles are members of other roles, allowing privilege inheritance and role-based access patterns.

content.name: Fence
children:
memberships:
  - role: inventory-editor
    members:
      - name: app-service
      - name: "deploy@example.com"
        admin: true

children: On supported PostgreSQL versions, pgroles generates per-membership options:

content.name: Fence

GRANT "inventory-editor" TO "app-service" WITH INHERIT TRUE;
GRANT "inventory-editor" TO "deploy@example.com" WITH INHERIT TRUE, ADMIN TRUE;

children: Memberships in the database that are not declared in the manifest will be revoked. Only declare memberships that pgroles should manage.

content.name: h3
children: Service account inherits a profile role

content.name: Fence
children:
roles:
  - name: app-service
    login: true

memberships:
  - role: inventory-editor
    members:
      - name: app-service

content.name: h3
children: Blue/green login roles sharing an owner role

content.name: p
children: For zero-downtime password rotation, two login roles alternate as the application credential while a shared NOLOGIN role owns all objects. Combining membership with a
at connect time, so objects created under either credential are owned by the shared role:

content.name: Fence
children:
roles:
  - name: combined
  - name: blue
    login: true
    config:
      role: combined
  - name: green
    login: true
    config:
      role: combined

memberships:
  - role: combined
    members:
      - name: blue
      - name: green
